summary: Import HTTP traffic and API schemas, model endpoints and isolated sessions, and execute bounded request replays.
limitations: Operates strictly under explicit destination allowlists and operational rate/request budgets.
Credentials and session identifiers are tokenized and redacted with deterministic truncated SHA-256 hashes.
Streaming binary WebSockets and Server-Sent Events (SSE) are modeled as unsupported features.
Live target probing requires explicit interactive authorization and non-empty destination guard.

demo.description: Execute offline synthetic replay and inventory inspection across imported API schemas and traffic captures.
